scope: Capture reviewed runtime support-file omissions and register external dependencies without deployment.

external_registration.boundary: A reference is not a backup. Directory references are not recursive content hashes.

verification.wasm_validation: 4 of 4 original payloads accepted by WebAssembly.validate
verification.rgthree_default_config: JSON parse passed after removing whole-line comments
verification.record_boundary: Checks cover the changed tools and captured payloads. The final committed tree and final staged scan are bound by the private FINAL.json receipt, avoiding a self-referential commit hash.

not_performed: Production deployment, restart, workflow changes, training or image generation
TypeScript compilation or frontend build; local Vue build dependencies are absent
Cold-start acceptance or complete reconstruction of every installed or disabled plugin
Model or database migration, automatic backup, encryption or off-disk recovery
GitHub push, new remote, release tag or maintenance version increment
rollback: This is a code and inventory-only commit. Review its inverse against the recorded base; never overwrite live databases or external assets from historical exports.
